observations: Photo 0 shows a large, dirty engine with various hoses, wires, and components attached. The engine block is metallic and shows signs of wear and grime. A black box with a label is visible on the front, but the text is not legible.

Photo 1 shows the same engine from a different angle, with a person in an orange shirt partially visible. The engine appears to be a complete unit, including the front and rear sections. The engine block is still dirty and shows signs of use.
The engine has a complex array of electrical connectors, hoses, and mechanical parts. No visible branding or model number is readable on the engine block or components.
The seller claims it is an LS460 engine and gearbox for Lexus cars, but no such label or marking is visible in the photos.

claims.claim: LS460 Engine and Gear Box for Lexus Cars
claims.evidence: No visible branding or model number on the engine or gearbox in either photo. The claim cannot be confirmed from the images alone.

risks.risk: The engine may not be an LS460 or may not be compatible with Lexus vehicles.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block or gearbox with visible model number or branding, preferably from the front or side.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic used engine/gearbox, not as an LS460 for Lexus

risks.risk: The engine may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the engine running or a close-up of the internal components (e.g., cylinder head, crankshaft) to verify condition.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be damaged or incompatible.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the gearbox housing or input/output shafts to check for damage or wear.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or incompatible

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
Clear photo of the engine block or gearbox showing any model number or branding.
Video or photo of the engine running or internal components.
Close-up of the gearbox housing or shafts to check for damage.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
